item.title: PTZ Industry Problem Map & Edge AI Computing
item.description: The security department at our campus swapped out three batches of PTZ cameras last year. The maintenance team’s fault list kept cycling through the same few items: faces in the lobby look like silhouettes under strong backlit daylight, night shots are wall-to-wall noise at low light, IR illumination attracts swarms of insects, and we get dropouts during cold snaps. Any one of these looks like “this camera is bad,” but what’s actually happening is that the PTZ product category is hitting boundaries in three layers: optical imaging, engineering deployment, and collaborative intelligence.
